📦 **Blockside `06d5e03`** — Fix shipyard cutout rails and prevent floating shipbuilding parts

Refs TASK-1350

Follow-up fixes for TASK-1350 shipRise construction animation:
- Remove runtime slipway box cutout hooks from 63_towns.js and 63_shiprise.js
  now that shipyard static decorative hulls are split into yard-hull twins.
- Replace score-based sorting with 26-connected Minimax connectivity propagation
  (shipRiseConnect + island bridge + curve-following colBot keel seed) and
  shipRiseUpperBound lookup for mThr so hull ribs grow cleanly from the keel
  and masts complete before yards begin, eliminating floating components.
- Add shipRiseFloatCheck diagnostics (floatCheck) and harden shipRiseSync /
  shipRiseOpen against async townRiseHides races.
- Rebuild Blockside index.html (5.56 MB, core c64ae0ab5041b5ec).

👥 參與者：@ridge-001
